rest_view_fit.method: Least-squares pinhole reprojection of 18 grid intersections and two front case corners; square width=(0.25-2*border)/8. rest_view_fit.board_frame: Origin at front case-edge midpoint on the playing plane; +x points away from that edge, +y across the board to image-left, +z upwards.
rest_view_fit.base_frame_prior: Camera x=0.21 m and board playing plane z=0.016 m were selected for a joint-feasible resting arm pose. Absolute base placement is not identifiable from this image alone.
